assumptions: The solute is conserved and the volumes add (no contraction on mixing).
limits: Cannot convert between molar and mass concentrations: that needs the solute's molar mass.
bio.jane/contract.question: How much stock, diluent or final concentration does a dilution need?

description: Solve C₁V₁ = C₂V₂ for whichever of the four quantities is left empty (stock concentration, stock volume, final concentration, final volume), each in its own unit: molar (M to fM), mass per volume (mg/mL to ng/mL), fold (X) or percent. Returns all four, the fold and the diluent volume to add. Refuses a 'dilution' that would raise the concentration, and two concentrations of different dimensions.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

final_concentration.description: final concentration (C₂). Leave exactly one of the four quantities empty: that one is calculated.

final_concentration_unit.description: the unit of the final concentration, given or solved.

final_volume.description: final volume (V₂). Leave exactly one of the four quantities empty: that one is calculated.

final_volume_unit.description: the unit of the final volume, given or solved.

stock_concentration.description: stock concentration (C₁). Leave exactly one of the four quantities empty: that one is calculated.

stock_concentration_unit.description: the unit of the stock concentration, given or solved.

stock_volume.description: stock volume (V₁). Leave exactly one of the four quantities empty: that one is calculated.

stock_volume_unit.description: the unit of the stock volume, given or solved.

name: solve_dilution

diluent.description: V₂ − V₁, the diluent to add, in V₂'s unit

fold.description: C₁/C₂, how many times the stock is diluted

solved.description: which quantity was solved, by its parameter name

value.description: the solved quantity, in its own unit
